intents.rationale: Add config definition and register as dynamic per-broker config in server DynamicBrokerConfig and DynamicConfig.Broker; validate entries against log.dirs or '*'.
Controller-side validation rejects dynamic set below 4.3-IV0; broker ignores static value below it.
Add CordonedLogDirs to BrokerHeartbeatRequest and BrokerRegistrationChangeRecord; controller persists it.
Filter fully cordoned brokers in placement.
core LogManager.scala dir selection skips cordoned dirs.
Integration test in server module; unit tests in metadata/tools modules are outside the declared test globs so they are listed as ordinary files.

criteria.text: cordoned.log.dirs can be set dynamically per broker; values not in log.dirs (and not '*') are rejected; removing the entry uncordons.
Below 4.3-IV0, dynamic setting is rejected with a configuration error and static setting has no effect.
Heartbeats carry cordoned dirs after catch-up; controller reflects dynamic changes without restart.
Auto-placed creation avoids fully cordoned brokers and fails with INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR when too few remain.
Explicit assignment onto a fully cordoned broker returns INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
Reassignment onto a fully cordoned broker returns INELIGIBLE_REPLICA.
AlterReplicaLogDirs to a cordoned directory returns INVALID_REPLICA_ASSIGNMENT.
Broker never creates a new replica in a cordoned directory even if the controller suggested it.
DescribeLogDirs returns per-directory cordoned state via LogDirDescription.isCordoned().
LogDirectoryCordoned and CordonedLogDirectoryCount metrics are registered and accurate.
Integration test cordons/uncordons via Admin on an embedded cluster and checks placement and errors.

tasks.summary: Implement KIP-1066 as one PR. Order: config definition + dynamic registration + MV gating; protocol/record JSON changes and LogDirDescription; core LogManager cordon state, metrics, dir choice; broker heartbeat; controller storage and placement/validation; ReplicaManager/KafkaApis; tool output; then tests, fixing existing metadata/tools tests broken by schema/constructor changes and adding unit tests there.
